parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The primary streaming domain for which you want to change the real-time log delivery configuration.

parameters.name: Logstore
parameters.description: The name of the Logstore in SLS to which logs are delivered.

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project to which logs are delivered.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region where the SLS project is located.
